artifacts.summary: Three-phase plan fixing the Validate Step 2 directory-path stale false positive and the normalize-authors --dry-run flag mismatch, with end-to-end live-index verification.

memory_candidates.content: When a filesystem-existence check iterates index/manifest entries whose path field admits more than one shape (file path vs. directory path with trailing slash), a bare `[ ! -f "$p" ]` test silently misclassifies every directory-variant entry as missing. The compounding failure is structural, not just a wrong predicate: the real checks usually live in the `else` branch, so the misclassified entries also escape every other validation in the loop. The fix is a three-way branch (directory / missing file / existing file) plus hoisting any data-source-driven checks (jq over the index itself) out of the file-only branch so they cover both variants.
